explanation: regionalSummary ranks regions by their pooled value (falling back to the donor mean without one) and carries an unassigned flag instead of compartment and sparse; donors are still counted once across regions. The Visium tile ranks the top five regional clusters other than Unassigned, draws a bar at the pooled value and a dot per donor, and explains the pooling; the sparse style is removed from search.css. Region names, the absence of a minimum-spot or sparse rule, and pooling every spot to summarise a region follow the HYPOMAP authors (Tadross et al. 2025, Supplementary Table 20 and Methods).
